title: Requirements on Overseas Retailers for Supply of Labour on Installation Works
what_it_is: Requirements on Overseas Retailers for Supply of Labour on Installation Works

sections.label: Penalties for illegal foreign workers
sections.summary: The Employment of Foreign Manpower Act allows fines up to $20,000, imprisonment up to two years, or both, and MOM can bar illegal workers for up to two years.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: Under the Employment of Foreign Manpower Act, illegal workers can be fined a maximum of $20,000 or subjected to imprisonment of up to two years, or both.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Manpower (Mrs Josephine Teo)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Manpower (MOM) has also taken action to bar such illegal workers from entering and working in Singapore for up to two years.

sections.label: Enforcement against illegal workers and retailers
sections.summary: Several hundred employers and illegal workers are taken to task yearly, and the public is asked to report suspected overseas retailers flouting rules so enforcement officers can follow up.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Every year, we take several hundred employers, several hundred of such illegal workers to task.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: If there is any reason to suspect that such overseas retailers are indeed flouting the rules, please help us by letting us know so that we can take action.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: We are saying that if they carry out activities that are against our rules, let us know if you observe such incidents happening.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Our enforcement officers cannot be in every household that is installing furniture.

sentences.speaker: Mrs Josephine Teo
sentences.text: Of course, whenever the information is received, we also have to do our due diligence and to follow up quickly.
